prompt: Is there an endpoint I can call to list every connector StackOne supports and the actions each one has? I want to show my customers what they can integrate without scraping your website every few weeks.
skill_note: Discovering connectors and actions is connectors territory; the reference endpoints are platform territory. Either may fire; the outcome is what counts.

fetch.name: fetches-catalog-docs
fetch.note: The v2 Connectors reference, the RPC page that documents GET /actions, or the Actions Metadata for Custom UIs guide.

reply.name: names-an-endpoint
reply.note: The endpoints that list connectors and actions.

reference: The v2 Connectors endpoints list connectors and return a connector's actions (List Connectors, Get Connector, Get Connector Action).
GET /actions lists the actions available to call, which is the documented way to discover them before making an RPC call.
The Actions Metadata for Custom UIs guide covers building exactly this kind of catalogue interface from the API.
The reply does not tell the user to scrape the website.
